hero.filename: Canadian and Afghan National Army soldiers patrol in Badula Qulp during Operation Moshtarak.jpg
hero.caption: Canadian and Afghan national army soldiers patrol in Badula Qulp, Helmand province, Afghanistan, Feb. 17, 2010. Operation Moshtarak is an Afghan-led initiative to assert government authority in the centre of Helmand province. Afghan and ISAF partners are engaging in this counter- insurgency operation at the request of the Government of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan and the Helmand provincial government. (U.S. Air Force photo by Tech. Sgt. Efren Lopez)
hero.alt: Canadian and Afghan national army soldiers patrol in Badula Qulp, Helmand province, Afghanistan, Feb. 17, 2010. Operation Moshtarak is an Afghan-led initiative to assert government authority in the centre of Helmand province. Afghan and ISAF partners are engaging in this counter- insurgency operation at the request of the Government of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan and the Helmand provincial government. (U.S. Air Force photo by Tech. Sgt. Efren Lopez)

images.filename: Bridging a canal in Helmand Province.jpg
images.caption: Marines with Alpha Company, 2nd Combat Engineer Battalion build a makeshift bridge  over a canal in Helmand province, Afghanistan, Feb.11, 2010. Alpha Company built numerous makeshift bridges, in order for Marines and vehicles to have a clear route to the Taliban stronghold Marjeh. (U.S. Marine photo by Lance Cpl. Walter Marino)
images.alt: Marines with Alpha Company, 2nd Combat Engineer Battalion build a makeshift bridge  over a canal in Helmand province, Afghanistan, Feb.11, 2010. Alpha Company built numerous makeshift bridges, in order for Marines and vehicles to have a clear route to the Taliban stronghold Marjeh. (U.S. Marine photo by Lance Cpl. Walter Marino)

images.filename: A Marine and his best friend (4525477229).jpg
images.caption: Lance Cpl. William Sullivan, a dog handler with the mobile section of 81 mm Mortars Platoon, Weapons Company, 3rd Battalion, 6th Marine Regiment, provides security with his dog, Coal, during a patrol in Marjah, Helmand province, Afghanistan, March 31. Marines from 3/6 and soldiers from the Afghan National Army are in Marjah to support Operation Moshtarak, a push to rid the area of Taliban presence and intimidation.

William Sullivan, a dog handler with the mobile section of 81 mm Mortars Platoon, Weapons Company, 3rd Battalion, 6th Marine Regiment, provides security with his dog, Coal, during a patrol in Marjah, Helmand province, Afghanistan, March 31. images.caption: A soldier from the Afghan National Army runs to a compound that he is about to search during a patrol in Marjah, Helmand province, Afghanistan, Feb. 25, 2010. The ANA soldiers and Marines from 3rd Platoon, India Company, 3rd Battalion, 6th Marine Regiment, patrolled through a residential area of the city to conduct counterinsurgency operations as part of Operation Moshtarak, a push to rid Marjah of Taliban presence and intimidation. (USMC photo by Lance Cpl. Tommy Bellegarde)
